title: The Farce of the Spear and the Shield
paragraphs: I’m not competing in the Colosseum this time, but I am the Colosseum’s bird, you know. My imaginary Father is making a snide remark, but I’m not paying any attention to the Filolial Mask. The Filolial Mask is a secret warrior… who punishes evil!
“I know you’re not the Shield Hero who’s currently wanted nationwide! Surrender immediately and confess!”
I landed on the ground and pointed my spear at the imposters posing as my Father.
“You ridiculous bastard wearing that weird mask! Hey! Come out, all of you!”
“‘Yeah!’”
And so, the villain impersonating my Father… summons a group of creepy impostors wearing animal-ear headbands from all around. What a shoddy production.
“I’ll teach this mask-wearing jerk a lesson he’ll never forget! Haaaaaaaaaah!”
And with the impostor posing as my Father leading the way, a group of burly criminals wearing animal-ear headbands each drew their weapons and charged at me.
“Hmph!”
I swung my spear powerfully to the side, whipping up a gale.
“U, uwaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
That alone was enough to blow the guy impersonating my Father and that shoddy bunch wearing animal-ear headbands right out of the picture.
“This is just the beginning.”

Whispering “Paralyze Lance,” I rendered the entire gang of criminals impersonating my Father unable to fight. Then, I tied them up with rope, dragged them at high speed around the city, and took them to the city guard.
“S-stop! I’m being dragged! H-help!”
It’s a public parade through the city. In the process, their masks fell off and their shields were shattered. They’re a pretty pathetic bunch for trying to commit crimes by impersonating my Father.
“We’ve captured a group of impostors posing as the Shield Hero.”
“Ah, ah… Who are you…?”
The security guards look at me with expressions of surprise. After all, they’d never imagine for a second that the Spear Hero would be apprehending criminals in a place like this.
“My name is Filolial Mask! I am the messenger and servant of the Saint of the Divine Bird!”
“I-Is that so…? W-Well, thank you for capturing the criminals alive. Um… as for a reward…”
“No thanks needed! All I need is the truth about the Divine Bird… Well then! Farewell!”

With a whoosh, I turned my back, transformed into a spear on wheels, and sped off in Drive Mode. Hehe… Now the bad rumors about my Father will be dispelled, and good rumors about the Divine Bird… Filo-tan—will surely spread far and wide. Oh? It feels like my Father from the first world is making a face of disbelief, as if to say, “No way! You idiot!” but that can’t possibly be true!

In that sort of vein, I had already nipped a few of the fake crimes—the ones my Father was supposedly accused of—in the bud beforehand. And so, for about two days, we went around eliminating criminals impersonating my Father in various locations. However, along the way, I happened to hear a story I hadn’t heard before.
It was a story about masked figures accompanied by Filolial resolving problems in towns and villages I hadn’t visited. I wonder if rumors are running wild?

I also heard that Itsuki had returned to his companions. It seems his conversation with Fleon-chan had come to an end. In any case, the date for reuniting with my Father and the others was drawing much closer.
“You came, didn’t you?”
“…Well, yeah.”

On the day I was supposed to meet up with my father-in-law, I waited in a meadow just outside Zeltoble, and right on schedule, my father-in-law and the others arrived with my finacée and the Shadow Boar. Glancing at Filo-tan, I noticed she no longer had that distinctive headpiece she’d been wearing until recently. Come to think of it, it seems I’ve missed my chance to meet the great Filolial-sama. As for this matter… I’m sure Filolial-sama will reach out to us. After all, there’s always a chance we might run into one on the way to Cal Mira Island or something.
“Did you manage to enhance it?”
“…Sort of, I guess.”
My Father nodded at my words with a bitter expression. As expected of you, Father.
“Well then, shall we head back to Melromarc?”
“Wouldn’t it be safer to leave Melty behind?”
Oh? Father has started calling my Finacée by her first name. I suppose quite a bit must have happened while we were apart.
“Wait a minute…”
“Bub.”
Kagebuta and my Finacée are starting to exchange glances here, as if having a conversation with their eyes.
“True, in terms of ensuring safety, there’s no problem with her staying here.”
“No way. I’m the one who caused this—I can’t just sit here and wait for Naofumi and the others to solve the case. Besides, who’s going to talk to Mother?”

My father, Big Sister, and Filo-tan are all staring at my Finacée right now. As for the battle ahead… well, I suppose it’ll probably be fine. After all, while my father and I are fighting, the Three Heroes Church is planning to launch a surprise attack with a massive army. We need to lure them out.

“Anyway, Na—Naofumi, head southwest while keeping an eye out for the Three Heroes Church’s assassins. When the time is right, I’ll team up with my allies to intercept you and engage them. The mastermind should show up after a while.”
“I get that your goal is to take him down… but are you sure you don’t need to meet with the Queen?”
“The enemy is cornered, you know. If the Queen returns, it’ll be game over.”
“I’d rather wait in a safe place until she gets back… Anyway, I don’t know what your goal is, but if you try anything foolish, I won’t show any mercy.”

My Father is getting pretty cocky now that he’s fully powered up. I still need to keep strengthening myself, but that can wait until this commotion is over. My goal isn’t… to become the Pope of the Three Heroes Church, after all!
“Of course, if anything happens…”
That’s right. Given the impression my Father has of me these days, if I say something convincing, he’ll surely believe me.
“Please—Raphtalia-chan and the others might get hurt. I’ll protect them even if it costs me my life.”
“That’s a response you’d expect from you…”
“Hmm…”
My Big Sister is looking at me with a suspicious expression.
“Hey, hey, Master. I get the feeling the Spear Guy is lying.”
Gulp! Filo-tan!? It’s true that Filolial-sama and the others have an excellent sense for detecting lies, but they really shouldn’t be showing it off right now!
“A lie, you say… What would he gain by deceiving us?”
“I have no intention of deceiving—Naofumi. I simply want you to act in accordance with my objectives. That’s all.”
With that, I lock eyes with Filo-tan. Eeeeeek… Ugh, she’s still terrifying. Fleon-chan, please protect my heart.
“Hmm?”

So, here’s the deal. It looks like it’d be a good idea to give some sweets to my Finacée and Filo-tan. I’ll use my spear to give cooking instructions and present Filo-tan and my Finacée with candy and chocolate. Remember, back in the first world, when the chocolate went wild, I unlocked the recipe for high-quality chocolate.
“Are you giving these to Filo?”
“Of course. I want her to do her best to protect Naofumi.”
“Filo will protect Master and Mel-chan! Master, Spear Guy, I think you’re lying about something, but you’re not lying to Master, right?”
“It just looks like you’re bribing her… Maybe we should just run away as is, Raphtalia.”
“I suppose so…”
I’ve been trying various things based on the advice of my Father—who ended up as a casualty of our Rival—but I have a feeling I might have gone too far.
“Well… even so, it’s not a problem, strictly speaking. However…”
I whisper softly into my Father’s ear. It’s a bit risky, but if I say this, he should believe me.
“Would you understand if I said I’m taking action to ensure that Bitch is brought to justice? I want you to help me secure the best possible outcome.”
“――!?　“I get it… It sounds extremely suspicious, but I’ll do as you say. But don’t blame me if anything goes wrong.”
“Of course.”

This is just part of the process to get my Father to agree, even if only somewhat. So, despite their reservations, my Father and the others returned to Melromarc as I’d asked and began heading southwest.
“Report! The Demon of the Shield is currently heading southwest… The kingdom’s reconnaissance unit has confirmed that it will likely pass near the village that the Spear Hero rescued!”

A short while after sending my father and his group southwest, we received a tip—or rather, a trap disguised as intelligence from within the kingdom—about the location where we would encounter my father. Just to be safe, I’d ordered a male soldier to relay the information, so I was able to hear it from sources other than the Crimson Swine as well.
“Oink, oink! Oo-oo-oo!”
The Crimson Swine jumped on the bandwagon here and started ranting about just how evil my Father was. It was all lies, you know.
“Oink! Oink! Oo-oo-oo-oo-oo! Oink-oink-oink-oo-oo-oo!”

Then, pigs like Crimson Swine jumped on the bandwagon to flatter me. I’m pretty sure they said something like, “Let’s avenge Ren and Itsuki’s deaths!” Huh? Did Itsuki and Ren die when we were fighting the Pope? My memory’s a bit fuzzy.
For some reason, the Lazy Pig is just standing here silently staring at me. I’m pretty sure he was squealing something like, “Let’s join forces and win for sure!” Hey, say something, will you?
“I absolutely cannot forgive this! Everyone! Let’s go!”
Ugh… I’m starting to get tired of making do with just Filo-tan, Fleon-chan, and Black Thunder’s feathers. I want to play with Filolial-sama and the others as soon as possible!

With that in mind, I decided to set a trap for my Father as planned and challenge him to a duel. It was near the southwestern village, which had been turned into a dense jungle by the Bio Plant, you see. I used the Capturing Thunder Cage to form a massive enclosure, ensuring my Father and his group couldn’t escape. It was quite an elaborate setup. You can’t set something like that up easily without knowing exactly where my Father is headed.
“O-oh no! The Shield Hero is under attack by someone!”
The people of the southwestern village are fleeing while crying out in shock.
“I’ve finally caught up to you, Naofumi!”
“……Motoyasu.”
Father’s hostility seems slightly less intense. At least, it’s lower than the hostility I remember from this situation.
“Naofumi, I’m pretty sure this is a magical item called the ‘Thunder Cage of Capture.’”
My Finacée says, looking at the cage.
“It’s a stationary trap designed to trap both the caster and the target.”
“What’s the purpose of this trap?”
“Its purpose is to prevent the target from escaping… but.”

My Finacée is looking not at me, but rather at Crimson Swine. She must know I’m lending him my strength. We’re about to have a back-and-forth about escaping, and she’s waiting for me to say something. True enough—they probably can’t react unless I say something. There’s no doubt this is a staged duel.
“Oink-oink-oink! Oink-oink! Oink-oink-oink-oink-oink!”
The Crimson Swine is making some kind of noise right now. I have no idea what it’s saying! It’s throwing off my plans, so just shut up!
“Shield Hero! And… Spear Hero…”

The people from the southwest village are looking at me with displeasure, while worrying about my Father. Indeed, this is sinful ground for me. By the way, just yesterday I donned the Filolial Mask and captured a guy here who was impersonating my Father. But you mustn’t dwell on that matter!
“Naofumi! Let’s settle this fairly right here! I’ll show you who’s right!”
“…Filolial Mask?”
Gulp!? There’s a villager here with a sharp intuition! Keep your mouth shut!
“I won’t go easy on you like last time.”
“…That’s what I was going to say… but what’s with that mask?”
I’d rather you didn’t bring that up! But my Father is surprisingly detail-oriented. It’d be best to change the subject.
“There’s a saying about which would win in a battle between a spear and a shield… but I’m the one who’ll win!”
Just a little more… just a little more, and the preparations will be complete. To be honest, as for the Pope, if we take him out the moment he appears, there won’t be a problem.
“Back off, you coward. No matter what you’re plotting, we’re not backing down!”

Father’s tone is a bit softer than usual. I’m sure he’s fully playing along with my plan. I’ll go as easy on him as possible, and with him in his enhanced state… this act should wrap up easily. No need to worry about going too far!
“‘Uoooooooooooooo!’”
With that, I switched to a weaker spear and charged toward my Father.
“Bubuhi! Bububu! Buhee!”

The Crimson Swine seized the moment to bellow and cast a spell to rain down a shower of flames, while my Finacée used a disruption spell right then. Since this method of disruption differs from dragon-derived magic, its accuracy is low. Oh well. I’ll quietly interrupt the Crimson Swine’s incantation.
“The Love Hunter, the Source of All Power, commands: Interpret the principles once more and disrupt the rain of fire raining down upon them!”
“Anti-Zweite Fire Squall”
In a flash, the rain of fire Magic the Crimson Swine had cast vanished immediately.
“……Huh!? Ah…… no, Anti-Zweit Fire Squall!”
My Finacée played along and pretended to cast an interruption Magic spell.
Sword……40% Bow……82%
